32b2608.summary: Shows or hides the stat counters (health, armour, melee/ranged attack, cost) on a card's UI. When showing, it refreshes the health/attack/cost texts and trait icons, then for units runs the dead-unit check: destroys a drop pod at 0 health, uses a survivor charge, turns the unit into a remnant, or marks it waitingToDie.
comments: Hiding the stats: hide each counter that exists; null checks that fail jump to the compiler's NullReferenceException
Armour counter is hidden together with its frame object
Cost counter is blanked by hand: flagged hidden, amount reset to -1 and every text component set to an empty string
Showing the stats: un-hide health, armour (frame follows activateArmour), melee, ranged and cost counters
Refresh all texts on the card script so the numbers shown are current
Only units can die from 0 health; spells and other card types stop here
Debug log line 'CheckIfDead called for <card> with cardState <state> and damageInfo ...' is built here
Card has no starting health (data field is 0): nothing to check, skip
Drop pod unit in a play state (state bitmask 0x2800C): if its drop pod health is 0 or less, the pod is destroyed
Copy the obscured (anti-cheat) current health into a plain int for the check
Still has health left: nothing more to do
Unit is not in an in-play state: log a warning and ignore the death check
Survivor charges left: the unit survives lethal damage by spending one instead of dying
Sacrifice-trait unit on its owner's turn also fires its sacrifice trigger first
No survivor: units that must become a remnant (and are not hidden) fire backlash actions then queue the remnant transform
Otherwise the unit is dead: mark it waitingToDie so the death is processed later
Hide the can-attack glow and ability animation, then fire the unit's death (backlash) actions
Decompiler leftover: unreachable null-reference throw for failed null checks

32b5534.summary: Coroutine step for SyncLastPlayerActions. Walks the logged player actions from lastActionReceived onward and resends each one to the opponent with RemoteSendPlayerAction, waiting a short delay (about 0.3 s) between sends. Used to catch up the opponent after a reconnect or missed message.
comments: State 1: resumed after the wait; move on to the next logged action index
State 0: first entry; start at the last action number the opponent confirmed receiving
Any other state means the coroutine is finished
Stop when the index passes the end of the manager's player action log
Decompiler garbled the index-to-string conversion here; it just builds the 'Resend action <i> <type>' log text
Log which action number and BattleActionType is being resent
Send this logged action again over the network to the opponent
Wait about 0.3 seconds (float 0x3e99999a) before the next resend, then yield and resume at state 1
Null check failure path (battle comms, manager or action log missing)

32b5728.summary: Throws NotSupportedException: this compiler-generated coroutine enumerator (SyncLastPlayerActions) cannot be reset. Never called by game logic.
